Typhoon Saudel causes flooding, mudslide in China; one dead, 11 missing

Typhoon Saudel brought torrential rain and flooding to China's coastal areas, particularly Fujian province. In Fuding city, firefighters rescued elderly residents from waist-deep floodwaters. Social media footage verified by Reuters showed the rescue efforts. A three-storey building collapsed into floodwaters in Fujian province. Separately, a mudslide in China killed one person and left 11 missing following the heavy rain brought by the storm. Local authorities responded by shutting schools, suspending public transport, and enforcing emergency flood protocols.
